notes.title: Devlog #7
notes.content:
Hello everyone! It's been a while since we've given you an update regarding development but now the time has come to show what we have been working on. Straight to the point here's what we've been working on.

We also have the Devlog video for those who prefer to watch it instead of reading.
[previewyoutube=4Xwsx-KMiPk;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Whats new?[/b]
[list]
[*] A new "Jumping" feature which is currently still being experimented with. This feature will allow for new puzzles and new areas to be discovered in the future!
[*] A new Charger Enemy. Armed with a shotgun and some fast running legs, the charger will try to rush towards you to unleash his deadly barrage of shotgun shells to take you out as fast as they can. 
[*] Prototyping with a possible new stylized art style which we will explain further below.
[/list]
[b]Graphics changes prototype[/b]
Ever since I began working on Temple Hunters, I envisioned a more Stylized look instead of the current square look also referred to as "Low Poly". So for the past weeks, I've been making some assets and getting a feel for a stylized look in the game and I would love your feedback and thoughts on this.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39050955/b401715c576af186fec8325035863e68ce9ddc5e.png[/img]
[i]Here you can see what the new desert houses may look like.

[/i][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39050955/36b28074e78cc3685e42454ed7be13fd273def71.png[/img]
[i]This is an example of an Egyptian Temple wall.[/i]

Here you can see two examples of what this new style might look like and I would love your feedback on this. Do you like this new look vs the older one? Does it feel fresher and cleaner? Would you like to see something changed? Please let me know down below.

[b]Development Changes[/b]
Finally, we have decided to change our roadmap and focus on what is important for Temple Hunters. In the past year, we have been working on a lot of new, and awesome mechanics for Temple Hunters but the most important thing that's currently missing is more maps. New maps and environments for you all to explore so we will be focussing more on this in the coming updates!

[b]Thank you![/b]
And that will be all for this Devlog, thank you all for reading and supporting the game. I always get very happy to hear your thoughts on the game, positive or critical feedback, or just the nice comments you guys have been giving me so thank you for that. :) And on that note, I hope to see you all out there, Hunting for Treasure!
- Niels

notes.title: The "Game Feel" update is here!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, after a week of work, listening to your feedback, and testing we are now releasing the brand new Game Feel Update! We haven't had the time yet to make an official devlog video because we've been working so hard on the update, but we are eager to hear everyone's response to the new update!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39050955/9aed292a2d52bc2bd1ba2a18e26338380afd94d3.jpg[/img]
[b]
So what's new?[/b]
[list]
[*] Player motion has been refined giving a smoother feel to the camera and the player's movement.
[*] Aiming of the rifle has been improved, allowing the camera to move to the point of where the player is aiming, to give the player an advantage over AI, and allowing you to spot your enemies earlier!
[*] You will now automatically respawn on death, you will no longer have to press "Space" manually :)
[*] Upon a kill or treasure claim, the screen will now visually show that you've gotten +100(or another amount) of score!
[*] The health bar is now animated, when losing health it will visually be represented, the same goes for gaining.
[*] When holding a shovel near a digging site, a new Icon will appear on the right bottom of the screen to show how much of the treasure has been dug up yet, to indicate the digging progress!
[*] Animations have been improved to look less like "Sliding on ice".
[*] We have started work on adding controller support (Xbox One) ([i]Driving, walking, aiming, and shooting, now works for the controller, but it is still in its early testing phase so reloading, choosing a weapon etc, will still require you to use your keyboard[/i]).
[/list]

[b]Bugfixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Aiming inside the Abydos Temple will no longer clip the camera through the roof.
[*] You are now able to aim through the pillars and other objects.
[*] Other camera clipping bugs have been fixed.
[*] You are now able to pick up treasure again.
[*] We've started work on Optimizing the Peruvian Jungle map for lower-end systems. So it should work better now.
[*] And a whole bunch of other bug fixes.
[/list]

I hope that the brand new aiming system will bring joy to all of you and improve your experience playing Temple Hunters. I appreciate all the support and amazing feedback from all of you. The next update will be the "Abydos Expanded" update so stay tuned for that!

Thank you all for reading this update, and I hope to see you out there, Hunting for Treasure!
- Niels

notes.title: Co-op update is here!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! After a long time of working hard on Temple Hunters we're now ready to release the 1st part of the co-op update! This update includes a new co-op mode, a new map, AI improvements, and more!

[b]What's new![/b]
[list]
[*] A new co-op mode, play with 4 friends (or strangers) together!
[*] A new map called the Abydos Temple.
[*] First edition of story elements, find out what happened in the temple and solve the clues given to you.
[*] AI now has a spotting mechanic, visually and audible represented.
[*] When the AI now calls backup, you will hear the siren go off.
[*] AI is now less OP after having gone through intense training with the Stormtroopers, meaning they will now hit you less often :)
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39050955/50335904aab96d5ca8c71dc57d88113bb5869a5a.png[/img]
[i]A screenshot of the Abydos Temple entrance.[/i]

A few other tweaks and effects have been added to the game for you all to explore. I am very excited for you all to get your hands on the update and hear your feedback. If you're up to date with the roadmap, our next update will work on [b]Game feel[/b] making everything feel more smoothened and refined so stay tuned for that!

Thank you all for reading this update and I hope to see you all out there, hunting for treasure!
- Niels

notes.title: Launch Day Patchnotes
notes.content:
Hello everyone and welcome to another Update post! Today is Launch day. We've worked hard on making everything as smooth and optimized as possible. We are excited to see everyone play the game, have fun, hear your thoughts, and meet a lot of you amazing people! Here are the patch notes!

[b]

[list]
[*] Localization has now been added to the game.

Thank you all for reading this update, I'm very excited and I hope to see you all out there, Hunting for Treasure!
- Niels

notes.title: Release Date & Devlog #6!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! The time has come after over a year of development, feedback, and excitement to Release Temple Hunters to the public! We have decided to release Temple Hunters on [b]the 21st of July 2021 (21/7/2021)[/b] to the public as an Early Access title! Early Access means that we will continue development while the player base will be able to get their hands on the game and give their feedback and of course most important, enjoy the game :).

The Price of the game will be [b]$10.99 or €8,99[/b] BUT the game will launch at a 10% discount for those who decide to buy the game during the launch. Like we have mentioned before, as the game keeps growing and developing, Temple Hunters may increase in price based on new features and content that we are going to add to the game.

[b]Devlog #6[/b]
During the Steam Festival, we have had a LOT of feedback and I am very happy to have met all of you and heard your thoughts. We have not been sitting still with your feedback and started fixing numerous of bugs and adding new features to the game. Here's a full list of everything that has happened.

[list]
[*] The Abydos Temple (Co-op mode/map) has now further been developed and is expected to be released this week!
[*] Localization has been added for the in-game menu's supporting English, Dutch, French, German and Spanish for now.
[*] The Jungle map now has a new spawn region for the German side and has new sites and temples ready for discovery!
[*] A huge number of bug fixes and optimizations.
[*] A new Victory/Defeat screen has been added.
[*] The player will not receive XP for killing and capturing points. XP will allow the player to Level up and in the future unlock new perks etc!
[*] Added option to Toggle Aim by clicking (no longer need to hold).
[*] Added invert mouse option to rotate the camera.
[*] Added Visible Damage effects when the player gets hit.
[*] Player names are now visible above friends and enemies.
[*] Enemy now shows up on the map when they shoot (not constantly but now and then) for you to track their movements.
[*] Allies now show up on the map as well!
[*] Cars will now start Automatically upon entering them.
[*] AI no longer shoots Invisible bullets
[*] And more!
[/list]

[previewyoutube=juHyuekWKRc;full][/previewyoutube]

Thank you all for reading and watching this announcement/devlog. It's been so far an amazing ride with lots of excitement, joy, and hard work. And I can't wait for the release date and to keep adding more and amazing/fun features to Temple Hunters!

That will be all for this huge announcement! And I hope to see you all out there, Hunting for Treasure!
- Niels

notes.title: Patch 0.4.13a, Character improvements, Interaction improvements, Ui and more!
notes.content:

I look forward to meeting more of you today during the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1459250/view/2999941807455184796]Dev Livestream[/url], and at any other moment when we're playing the game.

That will be all for this Patch! And I hope to see you all out there, Hunting for Treasure!

notes.title: Patch 0.4.11a
notes.content:
Hello everyone! We've released a small patch with some minor fixes and changes.

[list]
[*] The trucks from both sides should now be faster.
[*] The Chat now displays all the typed text properly. No longer will it clip into infinity.
[*] AI now reloads their weapons.
[*] Rifle damage has been reduced for balance.
[*] Boss Machinegun has been balanced
[*] Added vehicle spawn tent.
[*] Minor UI changes.
[/list]

To access the new Vehicle Spawn Feature, go to the following tent near your Base to access the spawning menu. Vehicles may differ per faction.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39050955/8554652ba071ed19973deda977a957368ae3b412.png[/img]

Furthermore we are looking at ways to balance the Rifle since people have described it as "overpowered" and a "One-shot kill". Which will be changed in the coming Patch. 

Second, the respawning of vehicles is currently not available yet, but we are also looking at ways to design a system for that which should hopefully be released somewhere in the coming patches as well.

Thank you all for reading and I will see you all out there, hunting for treasure!
- Niels

notes.title: Devlog 1
notes.content:
Hello everyone and welcome to our first exciting Temple Hunters Devlog! In order for us to converse our updates, we've chosen to opt for a video blog based system to update everyone on the latest developments. We'll still be using the website to communicate patches and a full list of updates, but for those who prefer a video, now there will be this option as well.

[previewyoutube=ZCbcHJT4JvE;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]What's new![/b]
[list]
[*]Progress has been made on the puzzle system.
[*]Puzzle system is now synced with other multiplayer clients
[*]The user interface has undergone some small improvements and downscales to improve visibility.
[*]The Peruvian Jungle map has been partially showcased, with new environments, jungle, temples, building and more!
[/list]

In other news we've got something amazing to celebrate! [u]We have passed 100 Wishlists on Steam![/u]
I would like to thank everyone for the amazing support and sharing the game. I'm very happy to hear people talk excited about Temple Hunters and eager to try it out them selves. Now that I'm able to fully work on it daily, we'll be making more progress.

Stay tuned for further updates and I'll see you all out there, hunting for treasure!

- Niels
